title: 공군공중기동정찰사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Emergency Military Measures, etc.)
(1) In the event of a disaster or where urgent military measures are necessary, the Commander may temporarily direct and supervise units other than those subordinated or attached to the Command, if such units are located within the jurisdiction determined by the Commander of Air Force Operations Command pursuant to Article 2 (2).
(2) Where the Commander has directed and supervised other units not subordinated or attached to the Command pursuant to paragraph (1), the Commander shall without delay report the circumstances to the Commander of Air Force Operations Command and notify the commanding officer of the higher-level unit to which the unit concerned belongs.
